cause_quote: #142713 deleted `if (props.inspectionError) { return renderRetryError(props.inspectionError, props.onRetryInspection); }` from renderAccess, leaving `if (!props.inspection) { return renderSettingsLoadingSkeleton(...) }` to run on failure, and moved the error to a page-level banner.
user_saw: After a plugin's permission inspection request failed, its Permissions section kept showing a loading skeleton forever (alongside the error banner) instead of a finished state.
summary: Plugin settings now derive the permissions loading state from whether the inspection read is actually pending, and suppress the empty-settings message while permissions are unknown.
reasoning: The access section was introduced in #135840 with an explicit inspectionError branch that showed a retry error instead of the skeleton, so failure was handled. #142713 (unify installed plugin detail tabs) removed that branch from renderAccess and kept the `!props.inspection` skeleton, so a failed inspection rendered as permanent loading; later refactors (#149246, #150234, #150235, #168758) carried the `!inspection -> loading` condition forward unchanged until this fix.
